description: This file contains utility classes for retry operations used in testing, including predefined delay strategies and a retry helper method that performs asynchronous retries with exception handling and cancellation support.

classes.name: RetryOperation
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate delay durations based on sigmoid and linear functions for retry logic.

classes.name: RetryHelper
classes.description: Contains an internal static method to perform asynchronous retries of operations with exception handling, delay strategies, and cancellation support.

methods.name: Sigmoid
methods.description: Calculates a sigmoid-shaped delay duration based on the retry attempt number.

methods.name: LinearWithTenMilliseconds
methods.description: Calculates a linear delay duration in increments of 10 milliseconds based on the retry attempt number.

methods.name: RetryOnExceptionAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous retry of a given operation, with configurable maximum attempts, delay strategy, and cancellation support.
